contexts.text: They station their emissaries as a spider places its web. SE 2376. SE 4269.
Infernal love and its concupiscences may be compared to a spider and its web.
Like a little spider in its web...
Involve it in reasonings as a spider does its prey with threads.
As many as the little spiders in the little ball made by one mother spider.
Does the spider think in its little head...
Evils are joined together like the progeny of a spider...
The internal and external of a spider. Explained.
On spiders. General article. SE 4889. SE 5199.
A diabolical Spirit who appeared like a great and horrible spider (was drawn down by his web from the interior Heaven) and crushed. Described. (Those who appear thus described. SE 4736.)
A spider seen descending from the Third Heaven by its thread. Explained.
Spiders of a larger and more ugly form were seen to descend from the middle Heaven. Explained.
I saw many females who appeared like spiders letting themselves down by threads when they were cast out of Heaven. It was their affections which thus appeared. These women described.
Deceitful falsities are signified by the spider's webs which they weave ().
(A solifidian Spirit) ordinated a Society as a spider does its web, placing himself in the middle... All such want to get into the Heavens...
